service_reserve.description: Expand reinforcement and recruitment through reserves, at a modest cost to civilian output.

service_mass.description: Recruit and prepare militia faster. Civilian output and public patience suffer under prolonged mobilisation.

education_technical.description: Prioritise technical skills for research and construction; financing the programme reduces tax efficiency.

education_universal.description: Broaden access to education and improve living conditions, while committing more public resources.

rights_emergency.description: Use exceptional restrictions to support security. Repression can increase resentment and weaken research.

welfare_universal.description: Provide broad social guarantees. Living conditions improve, but public financing becomes more demanding.

welfare_targeted.description: Concentrate social guarantees on selected needs with a smaller improvement and smaller fiscal cost.

industry_directed.description: Direct domestic investment to cheaper, faster construction at the expense of wider trade reach.

industry_open.description: Encourage industrial exchange and output; dependence on external finance raises borrowing costs.

labour_protected.description: Strengthen labour protection and reduce grievances, with a modest reduction in output.

labour_flexible.description: Allow more flexible employment to increase output; weaker safeguards can increase grievances.

migration_closed.description: Restrict exchange and movement activity at the expense of trade reach and research.

environment_restoration.description: Prioritise restoration and healthier living conditions. Construction must meet more expensive standards.

environment_exemption.description: Relax industrial standards to lower construction costs and raise output, at a cost to living conditions.

security_community.description: Reduce grievances through community security, requiring additional public resources.

security_military.description: Emphasise military defence and militia preparedness; civilian grievances can grow.

media_plural.description: Allow more public debate and civic organisation. Research benefits and grievances ease.

media_directed.description: Direct public messaging toward war support while limiting civic activity and independent research.

administration_regular.description: The ordinary division of administrative powers.

administration_local.description: Give local institutions more power to rebuild and organise, at a cost to central tax efficiency.

administration_central.description: Centralise collection and construction coordination. Local resentment can increase.

regional_autonomy.description: Expand self-government in this region to reduce grievances and improve living conditions. Effects do not apply nationwide.

regional_emergency.description: An exceptional mandate supports stability in this region but can increase local grievances.

recovery_social.description: Prioritise living conditions and reconciliation in this governed region.

recovery_security.description: Prioritise stability and basic living conditions in this governed region.
